history.summary: Freehold unit at Treasures @ G20, D14, 720m from Aljunied MRT, asking $958k at $1,012 PSF for 947 sqft (labelled 1BR but clearly larger — likely a 2BR or jumbo unit). PSF is a steep ~32% discount to the $1,495 median, but the series has only 10 URA txns.
history.rating_rationale: Very low $1,012 PSF and freehold tenure are appealing, but 947 sqft for a '1BR' confirms a misclassification — value should be judged on actual layout, not the headline bed count. Critically, only 10 URA txns means the 9.75%/yr appreciation rate is statistically meaningless. Boutique development limits liquidity. Paya Lebar Central is a real catalyst but doesn't rescue thin data.

history.summary: Freehold and below the ~$1,290psf recent average, but the 947sqft unit is the project's largest format (penthouse) being scored against a 1-bed cohort (psf_cohort_txns=0). The -47% age-adjusted 'discount' is mostly a size effect, not a true bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Treasures @ G20 is a 38-unit freehold (2015) where 1-beds start at 420sqft and run up to a 947sqft 1-bed penthouse. Recent resales average ~$1,290 psf (range $1,012-$1,543). This listing at $1,011.62 psf is at the bottom of the range precisely because it is the 947sqft top-floor large-format unit - large units structurally trade at lower PSF (v3.2 size-relative principle), so the -21% psf_premium_vs_cohort on 0 cohort txns and the -47% age-adjusted premium overstate the value. The $958k price matches the top of the project's current $648k-$958k range, so the price is real. Freehold is not a forward edge (v3.4). It carries the bedroom_sqft_mismatch flag. D14/OCR region prior is favorable, and a large freehold floor area for under $1m has some own-stay appeal, but as an investment the 'cheapness' is largely a measurement artifact and exit liquidity for an atypical large 1-bed is narrower.
red_flags: 947sqft scored as a 1-bed against a 1-bed cohort - this is the largest/penthouse format; PSF is low because of size, not value (psf_cohort_txns=0)
$1,011psf is the floor of the $1,012-$1,543 recent-resale range, consistent with the large-unit size discount
